notes: Black Knight lockup and Multi-Ball with direct public switch writes only. After a game start (as in the gameplay-causality scenario) each ball that comes to rest in the lockup trough (bottom 41, centre 42, top 43) is held and a new ball thrown from the ball ramp with solenoid 6, the ramp switches 18 and 17 emptying in turn; with the third ball locked the ROM starts Multi-Ball and, with all three lockup switches still closed, pulses the Multi-Ball release (solenoid 7); the lockup switches are opened only after that pulse, as the balls leave. Run from an NVRAM initialized by one prior empty-NVRAM power-up.
